title: My Class Speech
question: 把今天“认真准备 speech -> 加入 funny story -> 同学善意地笑 -> 分清 laugh at 和 laugh with”的表达，放进班级 presentation 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: I prepared my speech carefully for our class presentation. I included a funny story at the end. When my classmates laughed, I felt nervous and asked, "Were they laughing at me?" My teacher smiled and said, "No, they were laughing with you." To my surprise, my presentation was a great success.

options.label: A
options.scenario_zh: 说我为班级 presentation 认真准备了 speech

options.label: B
options.scenario_zh: 说我在结尾加入了一个有趣的小故事

options.label: C
options.scenario_zh: 说同学们笑的时候，我有点紧张

options.label: D
options.scenario_zh: 问他们是不是在嘲笑我

options.label: E
options.scenario_zh: 老师解释他们是在和我一起笑
